name: get_grab_operation
description: Read or update one durable grab change, list legacy reorder operations, or request the unified style+reorder batch. Applied/rejected/superseded changes leave the pending set.

batch.description: Return the unified current batch of reorder and style records; cannot be combined with operation_id or mark

mark.description: Mark a previewed reorder or sent style change

operation_id.description: Operation ID; omit to list all operations
